items.title: Isaiah Morgan Interview, 1958-12-01
items.q: T-Boy, that was the bass player

ctx.x: Can you tell us something more about your brother, since he isn't here anymore to talk for himself, about his first band? Do you remember who was in his first band and the band that made the records and all through that? Anything you can remember about him for a while?

Well, he didn't make no records until he got with me. The first band he had, it was Joe Watson, clarinet player, T-Boy, that was the bass player, that was the one my brother was trying to think of, a little short fellow. Then, the guitar player was Butler Red, we call him Guy A. I think I see, well, the drummer was Alfred William.
